claim: Rukia Kuchiki gives Ichigo Kurosaki Soul Reaper powers.
explanation: Rukia transfers most of her Soul Reaper power to Ichigo when they face a Hollow attacking his family.

claim: Ichigo Kurosaki's zanpakuto is named Zabimaru.
explanation: Zabimaru is Renji Abarai's zanpakuto. Ichigo's zanpakuto is Zangetsu.

claim: Orihime Inoue is a classmate of Ichigo Kurosaki.
explanation: Orihime attends the same class as Ichigo at Karakura High School.

claim: Uryu Ishida is a Soul Reaper.
explanation: Uryu is a Quincy, a human who fights Hollows with spirit-particle weapons. He is not a Soul Reaper.

claim: Yasutora Sado is nicknamed Chad.
explanation: Yasutora Sado is known to his friends by the nickname Chad.

claim: Kisuke Urahara runs a flower shop in Karakura Town.
explanation: Urahara runs the Urahara Shop, which sells sweets and everyday goods and also supplies Soul Reaper equipment.

claim: Yoruichi Shihoin can transform into a black cat.
explanation: Yoruichi often takes the form of a black cat while she lives in the human world.

claim: Byakuya Kuchiki is Rukia Kuchiki's biological brother.
explanation: Byakuya is Rukia's adoptive brother. He adopted her after marrying her older sister Hisana.

claim: Byakuya Kuchiki is the captain of the Sixth Division.
explanation: Byakuya serves as captain of the Sixth Division of the Gotei 13 when Ichigo first meets him.

claim: Toshiro Hitsugaya is the captain of the Eleventh Division.
explanation: Toshiro Hitsugaya is captain of the Tenth Division. The Eleventh Division is led by Kenpachi Zaraki.

claim: Rangiku Matsumoto is the lieutenant of the Tenth Division.
explanation: Rangiku serves as vice-captain under Captain Toshiro Hitsugaya.

claim: Kenpachi Zaraki is the captain of the Eleventh Division.
explanation: Kenpachi leads the Eleventh Division, the Gotei 13's most battle-focused squad.

claim: Genryusai Yamamoto is the captain of the Second Division.
explanation: Yamamoto is the captain of the First Division and the Captain-Commander of the Gotei 13.

claim: Sosuke Aizen is introduced as the captain of the Fifth Division.
explanation: Aizen is the Fifth Division captain, and his lieutenant is Momo Hinamori.

claim: Soul Society is the realm where living humans reside.
explanation: Soul Society is the afterlife realm where souls go after death. Living humans live in the human world.

claim: Ichigo Kurosaki's mother, Masaki, was killed by the Hollow Grand Fisher.
explanation: Masaki died protecting Ichigo from Grand Fisher when he was a child.

claim: Isshin Kurosaki is an ordinary human with no spiritual power.
explanation: Isshin is a former captain of the Tenth Division who lives in the human world, so he is very spiritually powerful.

claim: Isshin Kurosaki was formerly the captain of the Tenth Division.
explanation: Isshin gave up his position as captain of the Tenth Division and lived as a human after he married Masaki.

claim: Rukia Kuchiki holds the position of third seat in the Thirteenth Division.
explanation: Rukia is a third seat officer in the Thirteenth Division, serving under Captain Jushiro Ukitake. She is not a lieutenant.

claim: Rukia Kuchiki is sentenced to execution for passing her Soul Reaper powers to a human.
explanation: Giving Soul Reaper powers to a human is a major crime in Soul Society, so Rukia is arrested and sentenced.

claim: Aizen's zanpakuto, Kyoka Suigetsu, controls the perception of those who see its shikai release.
explanation: Kyoka Suigetsu causes complete hypnosis on anyone who has seen its release, controlling all five senses.

claim: Gin Ichimaru is the captain of the Third Division.
explanation: Gin Ichimaru is introduced as captain of the Third Division of the Gotei 13.

claim: Kaname Tosen is the captain of the Ninth Division.
explanation: Tosen leads the Ninth Division. He is a blind captain who follows a code of justice.

claim: Jushiro Ukitake is the captain of the Thirteenth Division.
explanation: Ukitake is the captain of the Thirteenth Division and Rukia's direct superior. He suffers from a chronic illness.

claim: Kenpachi Zaraki wears an eyepatch that suppresses his spiritual pressure.
explanation: Kenpachi's eyepatch is used to restrict his enormous reiatsu, which otherwise drains his own strength and that of those around him.

claim: Hollows are souls that have been corrupted and have a hole in their chest.
explanation: A Hollow is a soul that lost its heart, which is represented by a hole in its chest. Many wear a white mask.

claim: Toshiro Hitsugaya's zanpakuto, Hyorinmaru, is a fire-type zanpakuto.
explanation: Hyorinmaru is the strongest ice-type zanpakuto. Fire-type is Yamamoto's Ryujin Jakka.

claim: Renji Abarai's zanpakuto is Senbonzakura.
explanation: Senbonzakura is Byakuya Kuchiki's zanpakuto. Renji's zanpakuto is Zabimaru.

claim: The Gotei 13 is led by the Captain-Commander Retsu Unohana.
explanation: The Captain-Commander is Genryusai Yamamoto. Retsu Unohana is the captain of the Fourth Division.

claim: Orihime Inoue lives with her older brother Sora at the start of the series.
explanation: Orihime lives alone because her brother Sora died years earlier in a car accident.

claim: Uryu Ishida's grandfather Soken Ishida was a Soul Reaper.
explanation: Soken Ishida was a Quincy who trained Uryu in Quincy techniques.

claim: Rangiku Matsumoto is the lieutenant of Sosuke Aizen.
explanation: Rangiku is Toshiro Hitsugaya's lieutenant. Aizen's lieutenant is Momo Hinamori.

claim: Kenpachi Zaraki is a master of kido.
explanation: Kenpachi has almost no skill with kido and relies on his raw strength and swordsmanship.

claim: Genryusai Yamamoto's zanpakuto, Ryujin Jakka, is a water-type zanpakuto.
explanation: Ryujin Jakka is the strongest fire-type zanpakuto.

claim: Ichigo Kurosaki's mother, Masaki, was a Soul Reaper.
explanation: Masaki was a Quincy. Ichigo's Soul Reaper side comes from his father Isshin.

claim: Rukia Kuchiki killed her lieutenant Kaien Shiba after he was possessed by a Hollow.
explanation: Kaien Shiba, the Thirteenth Division lieutenant, was controlled by the Hollow Metastacia and Rukia killed him.

claim: Rukia Kuchiki's zanpakuto, Sode no Shirayuki, is a fire-type zanpakuto.
explanation: Sode no Shirayuki is an ice-type zanpakuto, described as the most beautiful ice-type zanpakuto.

claim: Kenpachi Zaraki's zanpakuto is named Nozarashi.
explanation: Nozarashi is the name of Kenpachi's zanpakuto, which he only learns of later.

claim: Kenpachi Zaraki's lieutenant is Ikkaku Madarame.
explanation: Kenpachi's lieutenant is Yachiru Kusajishi. Ikkaku Madarame is the Eleventh Division's third seat.

claim: Yoruichi Shihoin is known by the title Flash Goddess.
explanation: Yoruichi earned the title Flash Goddess for her unmatched mastery of shunpo.

claim: Toshiro Hitsugaya's childhood friend is Rangiku Matsumoto.
explanation: Toshiro's childhood friend is Momo Hinamori. Rangiku met him later and became his lieutenant.

claim: Kisuke Urahara was exiled from Soul Society after Hollowfication experiments were carried out on Soul Reapers.
explanation: Urahara was blamed for the incident and exiled to the human world, where he opened his shop.

claim: Renji Abarai grew up in the first district of the Rukongai.
explanation: Renji and Rukia grew up in the 78th district of the Rukongai, called Inuzuri.

claim: Genryusai Yamamoto founded the Shin'o Academy.
explanation: Yamamoto established the Shin'o Academy, the school that trains Soul Reapers.

claim: The Hogyoku was created by Sosuke Aizen.
explanation: Kisuke Urahara created the Hogyoku. Aizen later steals it for his own plans.

claim: Yasutora Sado is of Mexican and Japanese descent.
explanation: Chad's grandfather was Mexican, and his appearance and nickname reflect his mixed heritage.

claim: Rukia Kuchiki was adopted by the Kuchiki clan because she is Byakuya's cousin.
explanation: Rukia was adopted because she is the younger sister of Hisana, Byakuya's deceased wife.

claim: Orihime Inoue's Shun Shun Rikka consists of six fairies.
explanation: The Shun Shun Rikka are six fairy spirits that work in pairs and use her abilities of rejection and healing.

claim: Kaname Tosen's zanpakuto is Haineko.
explanation: Haineko belongs to Rangiku Matsumoto. Tosen's zanpakuto is Suzumushi.

claim: Uryu Ishida's Quincy powers come from absorbing Hollow reiatsu.
explanation: Quincy gather spirit particles from their surroundings to form their weapons. They do not draw power from Hollows.

claim: Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez is one of the Arrancar known as the Espada.
explanation: Grimmjow is the Sexta Espada, one of the ten strongest Arrancar serving Aizen.

claim: Ulquiorra Cifer is a captain of the Gotei 13.
explanation: Ulquiorra is an Arrancar and the Cuatro Espada under Aizen. He is not a Soul Reaper captain.

claim: Hueco Mundo is the realm where Hollows live.
explanation: Hueco Mundo is the desert world that is home to Hollows, Menos and Arrancar.

claim: Las Noches is the capital city of Soul Society.
explanation: Las Noches is Aizen's fortress in Hueco Mundo, not a city of Soul Society.

claim: Sosuke Aizen betrays Soul Society.
explanation: Aizen fakes his death, defects and leads the Arrancar against Soul Society, with Gin Ichimaru and Kaname Tosen.

claim: Aizen is killed by Ichigo Kurosaki in the final battle of the Arrancar storyline.
explanation: Ichigo defeats Aizen but does not kill him. Aizen is afterward sealed and imprisoned by Soul Society.

claim: Coyote Starrk is the Primera Espada.
explanation: Starrk is the Primera Espada, the Arrancar ranked number one among the Espada.

claim: Tier Harribel is the Sexta Espada.
explanation: Harribel is the Tercera Espada, ranked third. Grimmjow is the Sexta Espada.

claim: The Espada are ranked from number one to number ten.
explanation: The Espada hold ranks from Primera (one) to Diez (ten), and each has a number tied to their power.

claim: The Espada are Soul Reapers who serve Genryusai Yamamoto.
explanation: The Espada are Arrancar who serve Sosuke Aizen. They are enemies of Yamamoto and the Gotei 13.

claim: Ulquiorra Cifer is the Cuatro Espada.
explanation: Ulquiorra is the fourth-ranked Espada, known for his cool, emotionless manner.

claim: Nnoitra Gilga is the Octava Espada.
explanation: Nnoitra is the Quinta Espada, ranked fifth. Szayelaporro Granz is the Octava Espada.

claim: Szayelaporro Granz is killed by Mayuri Kurotsuchi.
explanation: Mayuri Kurotsuchi, captain of the Twelfth Division, kills Szayelaporro after a battle of two scientists.

claim: Coyote Starrk's partner Lilynette Gingerbuck is a part of his own soul.
explanation: Starrk's soul was split in two, and Lilynette is the half of his soul that became a separate being.

claim: Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez's resurreccion is named Santa Teresa.
explanation: Santa Teresa is Nnoitra Gilga's resurreccion. Grimmjow's resurreccion is Pantera.

claim: Ulquiorra Cifer's resurreccion is named Murcielago.
explanation: Murcielago is Ulquiorra's resurreccion. It turns him into a winged, bat-like form.

claim: Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez is killed in his first fight against Ichigo Kurosaki.
explanation: Grimmjow is defeated but survives and continues to fight. His first fight with Ichigo is not his last.

claim: Nelliel Tu Odelschwanck was formerly the Tercera Espada.
explanation: Nelliel was the third-ranked Espada before she lost her position and her memory, which left her in a child form as Nel.

claim: Baraggan Louisenbairn is the Quinta Espada.
explanation: Baraggan is the Segunda Espada, ranked second. Nnoitra holds the Quinta rank.

claim: Shinji Hirako is a former captain of the Fifth Division.
explanation: Shinji led the Fifth Division before he was exiled, and Aizen served as his lieutenant.

claim: The Visored are Soul Reapers who gained Hollow powers through Aizen's experiments.
explanation: The Visored were Soul Reapers whose bodies were Hollowfied by Aizen, and they then learned to use Hollow powers.

claim: The Visored are Arrancar who serve Aizen.
explanation: The Visored are former Soul Reapers who oppose Aizen. They are not Arrancar and they do not serve him.

claim: Aizen plans to use the souls of Karakura Town to create the Ouken.
explanation: Aizen needs the souls of Karakura Town's residents to create the Ouken, a key that gives him access to the Soul King's realm.

claim: Aizen plans to use Karakura Town's souls to create a second Hogyoku.
explanation: Aizen's plan is to create the Ouken, a key that leads to the Soul King. He is not trying to create another Hogyoku.

claim: Ichigo Kurosaki defeats Ulquiorra Cifer in Las Noches.
explanation: Ichigo defeats Ulquiorra, who dies afterward, when Ichigo rescues Orihime in Las Noches.

claim: Ulquiorra Cifer is killed by Uryu Ishida.
explanation: Ulquiorra dies after his battle with Ichigo. Uryu Ishida does not kill him.

claim: Ulquiorra Cifer takes Orihime Inoue to Hueco Mundo.
explanation: Ulquiorra, on Aizen's orders, brings Orihime to Las Noches, which prompts Ichigo's rescue mission.

claim: Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez takes Orihime Inoue to Hueco Mundo.
explanation: Ulquiorra takes Orihime to Hueco Mundo, with Yammy. Grimmjow is not the one who takes her.

claim: Gin Ichimaru's zanpakuto is named Suzumushi.
explanation: Gin's zanpakuto is Shinso. Suzumushi is the name of Kaname Tosen's zanpakuto.

claim: Gin Ichimaru is Rangiku Matsumoto's father.
explanation: Gin and Rangiku are childhood friends who grew up together in Rukongai.

claim: Kaname Tosen is defeated by Sajin Komamura and Shuhei Hisagi.
explanation: Komamura, Tosen's former friend, and Hisagi, his former lieutenant, defeat him during the battle in Karakura Town.

claim: Kaname Tosen is defeated by Kenpachi Zaraki.
explanation: Tosen is defeated by Sajin Komamura and Shuhei Hisagi. Kenpachi's opponent was Nnoitra.

claim: Aaroniero Arruruerie is the Noveno Espada.
explanation: Aaroniero is the ninth-ranked Espada, an Arrancar who absorbs other Hollows.

claim: Zommari Rureaux is the Sexta Espada.
explanation: Zommari is the Septima Espada, ranked seventh. Grimmjow is the Sexta Espada.

claim: Zommari Rureaux's resurreccion is named Pantera.
explanation: Zommari's resurreccion is Brujeria. Pantera is Grimmjow's resurreccion.

claim: Ulquiorra Cifer has a second stage of his resurreccion called Segunda Etapa.
explanation: In his Segunda Etapa form, Ulquiorra becomes even more powerful and shows a different appearance.

claim: Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez's resurreccion is named Pantera.
explanation: Pantera gives Grimmjow a feline-like form and is the resurreccion of the Sexta Espada.

claim: Baraggan Louisenbairn's resurreccion is named Arrogante.
explanation: Baraggan's resurreccion is Arrogante, which gives him the power to age things with his Respira.

claim: Coyote Starrk's resurreccion is named Los Lobos.
explanation: Starrk releases as Los Lobos, which gives him a pair of pistols and wolf-like traits.

claim: Szayelaporro Granz's resurreccion is named Fornicaras.
explanation: Fornicaras is the resurreccion of Szayelaporro Granz, the scientist Octava Espada.

claim: Tier Harribel's resurreccion is named Tiburon.
explanation: Tiburon gives Harribel a shark-like form and water-based abilities.

claim: Nnoitra Gilga is killed by Kenpachi Zaraki.
explanation: Kenpachi defeats Nnoitra in a long fight in Las Noches.

claim: The three classes of Menos are Gillian, Adjuchas and Vasto Lorde.
explanation: These are the three classes of Menos Grande, from the weakest to the strongest, and most Arrancar come from them.

claim: Aizen is sentenced to be executed after his defeat.
explanation: Aizen is sentenced to 20,000 years of imprisonment in the Muken, not execution.

claim: Coyote Starrk is killed by Kenpachi Zaraki.
explanation: Starrk is killed by Shunsui Kyoraku, who fights alongside Jushiro Ukitake. Kenpachi's opponent was Nnoitra.

claim: Baraggan Louisenbairn's Respira ability makes time rewind.
explanation: Baraggan's Respira causes rapid aging and decay. It does not rewind time.

claim: Tier Harribel is killed by Toshiro Hitsugaya.
explanation: Harribel is defeated by Hitsugaya, but she survives and later aids the Soul Reapers.

claim: Nelliel Tu Odelschwanck was killed by Nnoitra Gilga.
explanation: Nnoitra ambushed Nelliel and broke her mask, but she survived. She lost her memories and was left in a child form.

claim: Wonderweiss Margela is a Visored.
explanation: Wonderweiss is an Arrancar created by Aizen. The Visored are former Soul Reapers.

claim: Ulquiorra Cifer was a Gillian-class Menos before becoming an Arrancar.
explanation: Ulquiorra was a Vasto Lorde, the highest class of Menos, before he became an Arrancar.

claim: Getsuga Tensho is a crescent-shaped wave of spiritual energy fired from Ichigo Kurosaki's Zangetsu.
explanation: Getsuga Tensho is Ichigo's signature technique, in which he releases his spiritual energy through Zangetsu as a crescent-shaped slash.

claim: Byakuya Kuchiki releases Senbonzakura with the command "Roar".
explanation: Byakuya's Shikai command for Senbonzakura is "Scatter" (Chire). The command "Howl" belongs to Renji's Zabimaru.

claim: Toshiro Hitsugaya's Hyorinmaru is an ice-type Zanpakuto whose spirit takes the form of a dragon.
explanation: Hyorinmaru is the strongest ice-type Zanpakuto in the Soul Society, and its spirit is an ice dragon.

claim: Rukia Kuchiki's Sode no Shirayuki is a fire-type Zanpakuto.
explanation: Sode no Shirayuki is an ice-type Zanpakuto, not a fire-type one. Fire is the element of Yamamoto's Ryujin Jakka.

claim: Genryusai Yamamoto's Ryujin Jakka is a fire-type Zanpakuto.
explanation: Ryujin Jakka is the strongest fire-type Zanpakuto in the Soul Society, and its Shikai wreathes the blade in flame.

claim: Aizen's Kyoka Suigetsu works by controlling gravity around the target.
explanation: Kyoka Suigetsu is a hypnosis-type Zanpakuto that causes illusions. It has no gravity-control ability.

claim: Arrancar release their Zanpakuto through a process called Resurreccion.
explanation: Resurreccion is the Arrancar release of a sealed Zanpakuto, distinct from the Shikai and Bankai of Soul Reapers.

claim: Quincy abilities rely on gathering and manipulating spirit particles known as reishi.
explanation: Quincy collect reishi from their surroundings and shape it into weapons such as spirit bows and arrows.

claim: Soul Reapers use a high-speed movement technique called Sonido.
explanation: Soul Reapers use Shunpo (Flash Step). Sonido is the equivalent movement technique of Arrancar and Espada.

claim: Hierro is the tough skin that gives Arrancar defensive power against attacks.
explanation: Hierro is the Arrancar's natural defensive skin, and its strength varies with the Arrancar's spiritual power.

claim: Tensa Zangetsu is the name of Ichigo Kurosaki's Bankai.
explanation: Tensa Zangetsu is Ichigo's Bankai, a black katana-like blade that is more compact than his Shikai.

claim: Byakuya Kuchiki's Bankai is named Daiguren Senbonzakura.
explanation: Byakuya's Bankai is Senbonzakura Kageyoshi. The Daiguren name belongs to Toshiro Hitsugaya's Bankai, Daiguren Hyorinmaru.

claim: Toshiro Hitsugaya's Bankai is named Daiguren Hyorinmaru.
explanation: Daiguren Hyorinmaru is Toshiro's Bankai, in which he gains ice wings and a tail.

claim: Renji Abarai's Bankai is named Hihio Zabimaru.
explanation: Hihio Zabimaru is Renji's Bankai, the release of his Zanpakuto Zabimaru.

claim: Kenpachi Zaraki's eyepatch increases his spiritual pressure.
explanation: In the manga, Zaraki's eyepatch suppresses his spiritual pressure rather than increasing it.

claim: Genryusai Yamamoto's Bankai is named Zanka no Tachi.
explanation: Zanka no Tachi is the Bankai of Ryujin Jakka, the release of Yamamoto's fire-type Zanpakuto.

claim: Zanka no Tachi is the Bankai of Toshiro Hitsugaya.
explanation: Zanka no Tachi is Genryusai Yamamoto's Bankai. Toshiro's Bankai is Daiguren Hyorinmaru.

claim: Kisuke Urahara's Bankai is named Kannonbiraki Benihime Aratame.
explanation: Kannonbiraki Benihime Aratame is the Bankai of Kisuke Urahara's Zanpakuto, Benihime.

claim: Benihime is the Zanpakuto of Yoruichi Shihoin.
explanation: Benihime is Kisuke Urahara's Zanpakuto. Yoruichi is known for her mastery of Hakuda and Shunpo rather than a Zanpakuto.

claim: Shunko is a technique created by Yoruichi Shihoin that combines Hakuda with Kido.
explanation: Shunko is Yoruichi's hand-to-hand technique, in which she surrounds her body with Kido to make her strikes more powerful.

claim: Yoruichi Shihoin's Shunko is triggered by releasing the Shikai of her Zanpakuto.
explanation: Shunko is a Hakuda and Kido technique and does not involve a Zanpakuto release of any kind.

claim: Kyoka Suigetsu's complete hypnosis can manipulate all five senses of those affected.
explanation: Kyoka Suigetsu's Shikai creates complete hypnosis that controls all five senses of anyone who has seen its release.

claim: Kyoka Suigetsu's hypnosis is limited to affecting only the victim's sense of sight.
explanation: Kyoka Suigetsu's hypnosis is complete and affects all five senses, not just sight.

claim: When infused with Hollow power, Ichigo's Getsuga Tensho appears black with a red outline.
explanation: In the manga, Ichigo's Hollow-infused Getsuga Tensho is black with a red edge, unlike the pale blue wave of his standard attack.

claim: Zangetsu's Shikai form is a thin black katana, while its Bankai form is a large cleaver.
explanation: The forms are the other way around: the Shikai is a large cleaver-like sword and the Bankai, Tensa Zangetsu, is a thin black katana.

claim: In the Quincy arts, Blut Vene is a defensive technique.
explanation: Blut Vene directs reishi through the body to strengthen it defensively, while Blut Arterie is the offensive counterpart.

claim: Heilig Pfeil is a Hollow technique used by Vasto Lorde.
explanation: Heilig Pfeil is a basic Quincy technique that fires arrows made of reishi, not a Hollow ability.

claim: Hirenkyaku is the Quincy high-speed movement technique.
explanation: Hirenkyaku lets a Quincy move at high speed using reishi. Shunpo and Sonido belong to Soul Reapers and Arrancar.

claim: Kido is divided into only two categories: Hado and Bakudo.
explanation: Kido has a third category, Kaido, for healing, alongside Hado (destruction) and Bakudo (binding).

claim: Hado #4, Byakurai, is a Kido spell that fires a bolt of lightning.
explanation: Byakurai is a low-level Hado that releases a lightning-like beam from the caster's finger.

claim: Bakudo #81, Danku, is a healing Kido spell.
explanation: Danku is a defensive barrier spell. Healing belongs to the separate Kaido category.

claim: A Kido spell cast without its incantation is weaker than one cast with the full incantation.
explanation: Skipping the incantation lets the spell be cast faster but reduces its power compared with the full chant.

claim: Ulquiorra Cifer's Resurreccion is named Murcielago.
explanation: Ulquiorra releases his Zanpakuto as Murcielago, and he has a further form called Segunda Etapa.

claim: Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez's Resurreccion is named Murcielago.
explanation: Grimmjow's Resurreccion is Pantera. Murcielago is Ulquiorra Cifer's.

claim: Fullbringers gain their abilities because their fathers were attacked by Hollows during pregnancy.
explanation: Fullbring powers come from the mother being attacked by a Hollow while pregnant with the child, not the father.

claim: Ichigo Kurosaki lost his Soul Reaper powers as a consequence of using Mugetsu.
explanation: In the manga, Mugetsu consumes Ichigo's Soul Reaper powers and leaves him powerless.

claim: The four basic Soul Reaper combat arts are Zanjutsu, Hakuda, Hoho, and Reiatsu.
explanation: The four are Zanjutsu, Hakuda, Hoho, and Kido. Reiatsu is spiritual pressure, not a combat art.

claim: Ichigo Kurosaki obtained his Bankai in about three days of training under Kisuke Urahara.
explanation: In the Soul Society arc, Ichigo gained Tensa Zangetsu in roughly three days, which was unusually fast for a Bankai.

claim: A Soul Reaper can achieve Bankai without first achieving Shikai.
explanation: Shikai is the first release of a Zanpakuto and Bankai is the second, final release, so Shikai must come first.

claim: Gin Ichimaru's Bankai is named Kamishini no Yari.
explanation: Kamishini no Yari is the Bankai of Gin's Zanpakuto Shinso.

claim: Gin Ichimaru releases his Zanpakuto Shinso with the command "Shatter".
explanation: Gin's release command for Shinso is "Shoot to Kill". "Shatter" is Aizen's command for Kyoka Suigetsu.

claim: Adjuchas are the highest class of Hollow, ranking above Vasto Lorde.
explanation: Vasto Lorde is the highest Hollow class. The Menos classes rank Gillian, then Adjuchas, then Vasto Lorde.

claim: Sogyo no Kotowari is the Shikai of Jushiro Ukitake.
explanation: Ukitake's Zanpakuto, Sogyo no Kotowari, absorbs attacks and returns them with increased power.

claim: Sogyo no Kotowari is the Shikai of Shunsui Kyoraku.
explanation: Sogyo no Kotowari belongs to Jushiro Ukitake. Shunsui Kyoraku's Zanpakuto is Katen Kyokotsu.

claim: Baraggan Louisenbairn's Resurreccion ability, Respira, causes anything it touches to age rapidly.
explanation: In his released form, Arrogante, Baraggan uses Respira, an ability that rapidly ages and decays matter around him.

claim: Baraggan Louisenbairn's Respira ability freezes time in the area around him.
explanation: Respira causes rapid aging and decay, not time freezing.

claim: Tsukishima's Fullbring, Book of the End, lets him insert himself into a person's past.
explanation: Book of the End allows Shukuro Tsukishima to place himself into another person's past experiences.
source_name: Bleach Wiki - Book of the End

claim: Tsukishima's Fullbring is called Cross of Scaffold.
explanation: Cross of Scaffold is Kugo Ginjo's Fullbring. Tsukishima's is Book of the End.
source_name: Bleach Wiki - Book of the End

claim: Yasutora Sado's left arm is named Brazo Derecha de Gigante.
explanation: Brazo Derecha de Gigante is the name of Chad's right arm. His left arm is Brazo Izquierda del Diablo.

claim: Orihime Inoue's Shun Shun Rikka consists of seven spirits.
explanation: Shun Shun Rikka (Six Flowers) consists of six spirits.

claim: Yhwach leads the Wandenreich during the Thousand-Year Blood War.
explanation: Yhwach is the Quincy king and the leader of the Wandenreich, the force that wages war on Soul Society.

claim: Uryu Ishida is a Soul Reaper who fights with a Zanpakuto.
explanation: Uryu Ishida is a Quincy who fights with a spirit bow made of reishi, not a Soul Reaper with a Zanpakuto.

claim: The Royal Guard is also known as Squad Zero.
explanation: Squad Zero is the alternate name for the Royal Guard, the elite group that protects the Soul King.

claim: The Royal Guard exists to protect Yhwach.
explanation: The Royal Guard protects the Soul King, not Yhwach, who is their enemy in the Thousand-Year Blood War.

claim: Jugram Haschwalth serves as Yhwach's right-hand man in the Wandenreich.
